input.subject: The state of platform teams in 2026
input.content: Platform teams have changed a lot over the last two years. This issue looks at how.Section 1. Team size. Most platform teams we surveyed have between five and twelve engineers. Smaller companies tend to fold platform work into infrastructure teams.Section 2. Mandate. The most common mandate is developer productivity, followed by reliability and cost. Teams with a written charter reported fewer conflicts with product teams.Section 3. Tooling. Internal developer portals are now common; golden paths for new services are the norm. Several teams moved their CI to ephemeral runners to cut queue times.Section 4. Measuring impact. Lead time for changes and onboarding time were the two most cited metrics. Few teams measure developer satisfaction consistently.Section 5. What is next. Respondents expect AI-assisted tooling to reshape the golden paths, and platform teams to own more of the model-serving stack .Thanks for reading. Reply with your own experience; I read every response.
